step_down.meaning: Reduce scope to meet a constraint. Never reduce price at unchanged scope.

step_up.meaning: Hold price. Add value or a commitment structure.

repair.meaning: Assume a technical fault. Offer no incentive unless they say money is tight, then payment-plan flexibility only.

guardrails.discount_requires_commitment_term: A discount rung is valid only when bound to an upfront or multi-month commitment. An unbound percentage off a month-to-month price is a panic discount and must be rejected.
guardrails.downsell_reduces_scope: A downsell rung must carry a scope delta, not only a lower price.
guardrails.unpriced_piles_concede_nothing: If value_basis is modeled_opportunity or confidence_class is mixed, no rung may concede money. Zero-marginal-cost rungs only.
guardrails.every_rung_carries_a_condition: Milestone, results share, implementation step, or clawback.
